name: 🎢 Highest Ever Cart Obby
desc:
Are you brave enough to reach the top of the highest CART ever?

Climb the BIGGEST CART to come back down with the craziest Cart Rides EVER! ⭐

⚡️  Premium benefits: Premium players get free +5 speed   ⚡️ 

Make sure to CLIMB multiple times by rebirthing to unlock COOLER carts!
